items.html: By this you will well understand why crowns are placed on these thirteen letters more than on the other nine, and why the seven of them that are Shatnez Gatz have three crowns placed on each and every one of their letters, while the other six, which are Badak Chia, have only a single crown placed on each of their letters. The matter is that since Shatnez Gatz are the phase of the seven kings of ZON, from whose dross the shells called Satan Az were made and separated — hence they are called Shatnez, a combination of Satan Az, as mentioned in the Zohar, to indicate that from the force of the intense and powerful judgment came out Satan, which are the shells. They are also called Gatz to allude to what is said in the Zohar, portion Pekudei, that these kings are the secret of the 320 sparks that were scattered, like a smith who strikes iron and sparks fly out, and so on, as our sages said: “the spark that flies out from under the hammer” — and this is Shatnez Gatz.
